title: Splunkdbconnectmailmarshalintegrationdatabasequeriesusingpowershell
summary: Imported personal-notes SPL query from the "Splunkdbconnectmailmarshalintegrationdatabasequeriesusingpowershell" topic.
purpose: Originally captured in a personal Splunk notes wiki under the topic "Splunkdbconnectmailmarshalintegrationdatabasequeriesusingpowershell". Not independently re-authored — review before relying on it.
spl:
$connection = new-object System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection
$datasource = " SQL SERVER "
$database = "MailMarshal"
$connectionstring = "Server=$datasource;Database=$database;Integrated Security=SSPI;"
$connection.connectionstring=$connectionstring
$connection.open()
$query = @"
SELECT [Message].[TimeLogged]
      ,[Message].[BlockNumber]
      ,[Message].[BlockRecipientIndex]
      ,[Message].[MessageName]
      ,[Message].[ServerId]
      ,[Message].[MessageSize]
      ,[Message].[Subject]
      ,[Message].[TimeArrived]
      ,[Message].[FromUser]
      ,[Message].[FromDomain]
      ,[Message].[FromLocal]
      ,[Message].[Edition]
      ,[Message].[ActionType]
      ,[Message].[Classification]
      ,[Message].[Description]
      ,[Message].[RecipientUser]
      ,[Message].[RecipientDomain]
      ,[Message].[RecipientLocal]
      ,[Message].[FolderID]
      ,[Message].[Deleted]
      ,[Message].[SessionNumber]
      ,[Message].[BytesSent]
      ,[Message].[FirstInBlock]
      ,[Message].[ParentEdition]
      ,[Message].[HasAttachments]
	  ,[Content].[AttachmentId]
	  ,[Content].[ParentAttachmentId]
	  ,[Content].[FileType]
	  ,[Content].[FileName]
	  ,[Content].[FileSize]
      ,[Message].[IsTerminal]
      ,[Message].[MessageBody]
      ,[Message].[SpamCensorType]
      ,[Message].[RuleName]
  FROM [MailMarshal].[dbo].[Message]
	  ,[MailMarshal].[dbo].[Content]
WHERE [Content].[MessageName] = [Message].[MessageName]
"@
$command=$connection.createCommand()
$command.commandtext=$query
$result = $command.ExecuteReader()
$table = new-object "System.Data.Datatable"
$table.Load($result)
$output=$table|select filetype,fromdomain |sort-object -property fromdomain|group-object filetype,fromdomain
$output|foreach{
    $properties = @{
        'FromDomain' = ($_.name -split ", ")[1]
        'FileType' = ($_.name -split ", ")[0]
        'Count' = $_.count
    }
    $psobject = new-object psobject -property $properties
    $csv += $psobject
}
$command.EndExecuteReader()
$csv|export-csv c:\perflogs\export.csv

| eval warm_bucket_size = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.home.warm_bucket_size'), 'bucket_dirs.home.warm_bucket_size', 'bucket_dirs.home.size')
| eval cold_bucket_size = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.cold.bucket_size'), 'bucket_dirs.cold.bucket_size', 'bucket_dirs.cold.size')
| eval hot_bucket_size = if(isnotnull(cold_bucket_size), total_size - cold_bucket_size - warm_bucket_size, total_size - warm_bucket_size)
| eval thawed_bucket_size = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.thawed.bucket_size'), 'bucket_dirs.thawed.bucket_size', 'bucket_dirs.thawed.size')
| eval warm_bucket_size_gb = if(isnull(warm_bucket_size), 0, round(warm_bucket_size / 1024, 2))
| eval hot_bucket_size_gb = if(isnull(hot_bucket_size), 0, round(hot_bucket_size / 1024, 2))
| eval cold_bucket_size_gb = if(isnull(cold_bucket_size), 0, round(cold_bucket_size / 1024, 2))
| eval thawed_bucket_size_gb = if(isnull(thawed_bucket_size), 0, round(thawed_bucket_size / 1024, 2))

| eval warm_bucket_count = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.home.warm_bucket_count'), 'bucket_dirs.home.warm_bucket_count', 0)
| eval hot_bucket_count = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.home.hot_bucket_count'), 'bucket_dirs.home.hot_bucket_count', 0)
| eval cold_bucket_count = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.cold.bucket_count'), 'bucket_dirs.cold.bucket_count', 0)
| eval thawed_bucket_count = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.thawed.bucket_count'), 'bucket_dirs.thawed.bucket_count', 0)
| eval home_event_count = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.home.event_count'), 'bucket_dirs.home.event_count', 0)
| eval cold_event_count = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.cold.event_count'), 'bucket_dirs.cold.event_count', 0)
| eval thawed_event_count = if(isnotnull('bucket_dirs.thawed.event_count'), 'bucket_dirs.thawed.event_count', 0)

| eval home_bucket_size_gb = round((warm_bucket_size + hot_bucket_size) / 1024, 2)
| eval home_bucket_size_gb = if(isnull(home_bucket_size_gb), 0, home_bucket_size_gb)
| eval home_bucket_capacity_gb = if(isnull('homePath.maxDataSizeMB') OR 'homePath.maxDataSizeMB' == 0, "unlimited", round('homePath.maxDataSizeMB' / 1024, 2))
| eval home_bucket_capacity_gb = if(isnull(home_bucket_capacity_gb), "unlimited", home_bucket_capacity_gb)
| eval home_bucket_usage_gb = home_bucket_size_gb." / ".home_bucket_capacity_gb
| eval cold_bucket_capacity_gb = if(isnull('coldPath.maxDataSizeMB') OR 'coldPath.maxDataSizeMB' = 0, "unlimited", round('coldPath.maxDataSizeMB' / 1024, 2))
| eval cold_bucket_usage_gb = cold_bucket_size_gb." / ".cold_bucket_capacity_gb

| eval currentDBSizeGB = round(currentDBSizeMB / 1024, 2)
| eval maxTotalDataSizeGB = if(maxTotalDataSizeMB = 0, "unlimited", round(maxTotalDataSizeMB / 1024, 2))
| eval disk_usage_gb = currentDBSizeGB." / ".maxTotalDataSizeGB

| eval currentTimePeriodDay = round((now() - strptime(minTime,"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")) / 86400, 0)
| eval currentTimePeriodDay = if(isnull(currentTimePeriodDay), 0, currentTimePeriodDay)
| eval frozenTimePeriodDay = round(frozenTimePeriodInSecs / 86400, 0)
| eval frozenTimePeriodDay = if(isnull(frozenTimePeriodDay) OR frozenTimePeriodDay == 0, "unlimited", frozenTimePeriodDay)
| eval freeze_period_viz_day = currentTimePeriodDay." / ".frozenTimePeriodDay

| eval total_bucket_count = toString(if(isnotnull(total_bucket_count), total_bucket_count, 0), "commas")
| eval totalEventCount = toString(if(isnotnull(totalEventCount), totalEventCount, 0), "commas")
| eval total_raw_size_gb = round(total_raw_size / 1024, 2)
| eval avg_bucket_size_gb = round(currentDBSizeGB / total_bucket_count, 2)
| eval compress_ratio = round(total_raw_size_gb / currentDBSizeGB, 2)." : 1"

| fields title, datatype
    currentDBSizeGB, totalEventCount, total_bucket_count,  avg_bucket_size_gb,
    total_raw_size_gb, compress_ratio, minTime, maxTime
    freeze_period_viz_day, disk_usage_gb, home_bucket_usage_gb, cold_bucket_usage_gb,
    hot_bucket_size_gb, warm_bucket_size_gb, cold_bucket_size_gb, thawed_bucket_size_gb,
    hot_bucket_count,   warm_bucket_count,   cold_bucket_count,   thawed_bucket_count,
    home_event_count,   cold_event_count,    thawed_event_count,
    homePath, homePath_expanded, coldPath, coldPath_expanded, thawedPath, thawedPath_expanded, summaryHomePath_expanded, tstatsHomePath, tstatsHomePath_expanded,
    maxTotalDataSizeMB, frozenTimePeriodInSecs, homePath.maxDataSizeMB, coldPath.maxDataSizeMB,
    maxDataSize, maxHotBuckets, maxWarmDBCount | search title=*
            | fields title hot_bucket_count, warm_bucket_count, cold_bucket_count, thawed_bucket_count hot_bucket_size_gb, warm_bucket_size_gb, cold_bucket_size_gb, thawed_bucket_size_gb
            | rename hot_bucket_count as Hot_buckets, warm_bucket_count as Warm_buckets, cold_bucket_count as Cold_buckets, cold_bucket_size_gb as Cold_size, thawed_bucket_count as Thawed, thawed_bucket_size_gb as Thawed_size, hot_bucket_size_gb as Hot_size, warm_bucket_size_gb as Warm_size
            | eval bucket_dir = ""
